# TradingView Animated Wallpaper

> Free, MIT-licensed animated chart backgrounds for TradingView Desktop on macOS and the TradingView website in Google Chrome. Local MP4/WebM/GIF/image wallpapers behind candlesticks; no subscription or cloud account for this tool.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/vladimirdd96/tradingview-animated-wallpaper

Two distinct packages are included. The Desktop companion attaches to the actual existing macOS Electron app; the Chrome Manifest V3 extension runs only in a browser. Do not substitute a Chrome shortcut for Desktop support. Desktop 3.4.0 on macOS/Apple Silicon is verified; future versions are not guaranteed.

## Install and use

- [Overview and downloads](https://github.com/vladimirdd96/tradingview-animated-wallpaper/blob/main/README.md): package selection, features, quick start, and FAQ.
- [Desktop setup and wallpaper controls](https://github.com/vladimirdd96/tradingview-animated-wallpaper/blob/main/desktop/README.md): attach to an already-running app; reopen controls with the top-right three-dot menu → Wallpaper settings…. Run Enable Desktop Wallpaper.command once after an app restart to reattach.
- [Chrome extension setup](https://github.com/vladimirdd96/tradingview-animated-wallpaper/blob/main/chrome-extension/README.md): Load unpacked using the directory containing manifest.json; choose a custom wallpaper through the popup.
- [Downloads](https://github.com/vladimirdd96/tradingview-animated-wallpaper/releases/latest): separate no-build Desktop and Chrome ZIP assets.

## Technical reference

- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/vladimirdd96/tradingview-animated-wallpaper/blob/main/AGENTS.md): boundaries, file map, and validation commands.
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/vladimirdd96/tradingview-animated-wallpaper/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md): tested platforms and limits.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/vladimirdd96/tradingview-animated-wallpaper/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Canvas 2D hooks, media layers, and Desktop runtime attachment.
- [Security and privacy](https://github.com/vladimirdd96/tradingview-animated-wallpaper/blob/main/docs/security.md): local storage, permissions, loopback controller, and exclusions.
- [Testing](https://github.com/vladimirdd96/tradingview-animated-wallpaper/blob/main/docs/testing.md): recorded live validation and reproducible commands.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/vladimirdd96/tradingview-animated-wallpaper/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): development and bug-report guidance.

No Naruto/anime footage or other user media is included. This project is not affiliated with TradingView or ChartSkins and does not unlock paid service features.
